# Membrane Realtimer plugin v0.11.1 - Table of Contents

> Membrane plugin for limiting playback speed to realtime

## Pages

- [Membrane Realtimer plugin](https://membrane-realtimer-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://membrane-realtimer-plugin.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.Realtimer](https://membrane-realtimer-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Realtimer.md): Sends buffers to the output in real time, according to buffers' timestamps.
- [Membrane.Realtimer.Events.Reset](https://membrane-realtimer-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.Realtimer.Events.Reset.md): Event, that resets `Membrane.Realtimer`.
